vaulting.title: Ledge Grip
vaulting.description: Unlocks Cling To Cliff and Climb Up in ParCool, allowing you to grab block ledges and pull yourself up.

soft_landing_1.title: Soft Landing
soft_landing_1.description: Each node reduces fall damage by 15%.

soft_landing_2.title: Soft Landing
soft_landing_2.description: Each node reduces fall damage by 15%.

wall_grip.title: Advanced Parkour
wall_grip.description: Unlocks sprinting, vaulting, sliding, crawling, diving, fast swimming, safe landing, pole climbing, wall slide, wall jump and wall running in ParCool.

grappler_license.title: Grappler License
grappler_license.description: Allows use of standard and motorized Grappling Hooks. Ender equipment requires the Ender Traversal specialization.

scavenger_1.title: Scavenger
scavenger_1.description: Each node adds +3% eligible container bonus chance and +0.5 Luck.

forager_1.description: Each node adds +5% chance for one extra eligible natural food drop.

forager_2.title: Forager

prospector_1.description: Each node adds +2% chance for one extra raw ore from eligible ore blocks.

backpack_license.title: Backpack Training
backpack_license.description: Allows equipping and opening the Quark Backpack.

cartography.title: Cartography & Minimap
cartography.description: Unlocks Xaero's World Map and Minimap. Press M for the full map; the minimap records nearby visited terrain.

lumberjack.title: Lumberjack
lumberjack.description: Fells a whole tree when its lowest log is broken with an axe. This intermediate milestone leads to the Scavenging specializations.

marksman_1.title: Marksman
marksman_1.description: Each node grants +2% projectile damage, including compatible firearms.

marksman_2.title: Marksman
marksman_2.description: Each node grants +2% projectile damage, including compatible firearms.

marksman_3.title: Marksman
marksman_3.description: Each node grants +2% projectile damage, including compatible firearms.

executioner.title: Executioner
executioner.description: Deal 15% more damage to enemies at or below 25% health. Shared intermediate milestone.

pain_tolerance.title: Pain Tolerance
pain_tolerance.description: At 20% health or lower, gain Resistance I for 60 seconds. 5-minute cooldown. Your first Combat specialization opens the other Combat paths.

second_wind.title: Second Wind
second_wind.description: Killing a hostile mob restores 2 health over 4 seconds. 10-second cooldown. Your first Combat specialization opens the other Combat paths.

maintenance_1.title: Maintenance
maintenance_1.description: Each node adds 5% chance for tools, weapons and armor to avoid durability loss.

maintenance_2.title: Maintenance
maintenance_2.description: Each node adds 5% chance for tools, weapons and armor to avoid durability loss.

maintenance_3.title: Maintenance
maintenance_3.description: Each node adds 5% chance for tools, weapons and armor to avoid durability loss.

gunsmithing.title: Gunsmithing
gunsmithing.description: Unlocks firearm crafting in the custom Workbench.

ammunition_1.title: Ammunition I
ammunition_1.description: Unlocks standard firearm ammunition in the custom Workbench.

ammunition_2.title: Ammunition II
ammunition_2.description: Unlocks advanced and specialty ammunition in the custom Workbench.

mechanics_1.title: Mechanical Foundations
mechanics_1.description: Unlocks Create kinetic sources, shafts, cogs, belts and basic transmission components.

mechanics_2.title: Mechanical Processing
mechanics_2.description: Unlocks Create presses, mixers, saws, deployers and processing components.

automation.title: Advanced Manufacturing
automation.description: Unlocks advanced Create components required before choosing Create Automation.

fortification_1.title: Fortification 1
fortification_1.description: Unlocks Tier I fortification blocks; zombies break them at 80% effectiveness.

fortification_2.title: Fortification 2
fortification_2.description: Unlocks Tier II fortification blocks; zombies break them at 60% effectiveness.

fortification_3.title: Fortification 3
fortification_3.description: Unlocks Tier III fortification blocks; zombies break them at 35% effectiveness.

fortification_4.title: Structural Engineering
fortification_4.description: Advanced structural knowledge required before choosing a final Engineering specialization.

adrenaline_rush.title: Emergency Mobility
adrenaline_rush.description: At 20% health or lower, gain +20% movement speed and unlimited ParCool stamina for 15 seconds. 3-minute cooldown. Your first Mobility specialization opens the other Mobility paths.

efficient_metabolism.title: Efficient Metabolism
efficient_metabolism.description: Reduces exhaustion generated by all activities by 3%.

enduring_vitality.title: Enduring Vitality
enduring_vitality.description: After 20 seconds without taking damage, slowly restores 1 health every 45 seconds. Your first Combat specialization opens the other Combat paths.

field_recovery.title: Field Recovery
field_recovery.description: Common Golden Apples restore 2 permanently lost hearts instead of 1. Shared intermediate milestone.

key_hunter.title: Key Hunter
key_hunter.description: Raises eligible mob key drops to 4% / 6% / 15% / 30% by level, and Fallen Adventurer skeleton chances to 68% / 36% / 25% / 15%.

sentry_engineering.title: Sentry Engineering
sentry_engineering.description: Unlocks the Basic Turret and raises your global turret capacity to 1.

turret_engineering.title: Turret Engineering
turret_engineering.description: Unlocks Auto and Shotgun Turrets and raises your global turret capacity to 2.

automated_defense.title: Automated Defense
automated_defense.description: Unlocks the Explosive Turret, advanced turret modules and raises global turret capacity to 3. Explosive Turrets consume 2 capacity.

create_automation.title: Create Automation
create_automation.description: Unlocks Create automatic assembly, logistics, trains and advanced production systems.

fortress_construction.title: Fortress Construction
fortress_construction.description: Allows placing Smooth Stone as a permanent fortification that Enhanced AI miners cannot break.

salvager.title: Salvager
salvager.description: Allows placing and using the Recycler to recover part of the base materials from damaged or unwanted equipment.

breakfall_reflex.title: Breakfall Reflex
breakfall_reflex.description: Completely prevents one instance of fall damage, then enters a 30-second cooldown. Your first Mobility specialization opens the other Mobility paths.

ender_traversal.title: Ender Traversal
ender_traversal.description: Allows use of the Ender Staff and Ender Grappling Hook. Your first Mobility specialization opens the other Mobility paths.

dark_adaptation.title: Dark Adaptation
dark_adaptation.description: Raises minimum visibility in darkness to approximately 25% without granting full Night Vision. Planned Scavenging specialization.

key_conservation.title: Key Conservation
key_conservation.description: When unlocking a chest, has a 30% absolute chance to preserve the required key. Your first Scavenging specialization opens the other Scavenging paths.

master_salvager.title: Master Salvager
master_salvager.description: Improves Workbench dismantling efficiency while still excluding rare components. Your first Scavenging specialization opens the other Scavenging paths.

haggler_1.title: Haggler
haggler_1.description: Reduces merchant prices by 5% per node; current node contributes 5%, maximum 15%.

field_dressing_1.title: Field Dressing
field_dressing_1.description: Increases eligible animal resource yields by 10% per node; maximum 30%.

repair_efficiency_1.title: Repair Efficiency
repair_efficiency_1.description: Increases durability restored by repair kits by 10% per node; maximum 30%.

workshop_efficiency_1.title: Workshop Efficiency
workshop_efficiency_1.description: Adds an 8% chance per node to preserve one common component used in the Custom Workbench; maximum 24%.

survivor_root.title: Survivor
survivor_root.description: Starting point of the skill tree. Unlock this node first, then choose among Mobility, Exploration & Scavenging, Combat and Engineering.

waypoint_navigation.title: Waypoint Navigation
waypoint_navigation.description: Unlocks waypoint creation and display in Xaero's map system.

low_profile.title: Low Profile
low_profile.description: Hostile mobs acquire you only at 65% of their normal detection distance. Close enemies can still notice and pursue you.

double_jump.title: Reserve Jump
double_jump.description: Press Jump again while airborne to perform a second jump. The ability has a 30-second cooldown.

beast_rider.title: Beast Rider
beast_rider.description: Allows riding Alex's Mobs mounts after their normal taming or equipment requirements are met.

aquatic_mobility.title: Aquatic Mobility
aquatic_mobility.description: Grants +20% swimming speed for faster traversal through rivers, oceans and flooded caves.
